concept.name: gross margin
concept.canonical_definition: revenue minus cost of goods sold, expressed as value or ratio
concept.mechanism: subtract attributable cost of goods sold from revenue

audience.prior_knowledge: understands revenue, confuses margin with cash

explanation.plain_language: Gross margin shows what remains after the direct cost of what was sold.
examples: deal revenue 100, defined cost of goods sold 60, gross margin 40
non_examples: cash balance is not gross margin

mappings: ingredient cost maps to cost of goods sold
breakpoints: cash timing and operating expenses are outside the analogy
